cohort: 18,217 term singleton births from Geisinger, PA from 2006 to 2015.
finding: Most pregnant women (74.2%) had GWG outside of Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommendations, and GWG outside of recommendations resulted in poorer birth outcomes, particularly in underweight and obese women.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery prevalence was highest for women with GWG above recommendations, regardless of BMI.
birth_weight: Reported, but specific values not provided
